summary: PRF Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, LTD. (Yorkville) for up to $15.0 million in ordinary shares over 36 months. Shares are sold at 97% of the lowest of three daily VWAPs during a three-day period, with a 1.0% commitment fee paid partly in shares. A prior $10.0 million agreement terminated after full drawdown. Yorkville's ownership is capped at 9.99%. The deal functions as an at-the-market equity facility, providing PRF with flexible capital access. Watch for share dilution from subsequent advances and the effectiveness of the required registration statement.
